title: Re-run failures, never verdicts
statement: Re-run only a check that failed to finish, never one whose verdict was unwelcome, and certify nothing on missing evidence.
example: Re-running only the errored attempts turned 2 false certifications into leaks.
detail: In one unit's gate, certification needed a full set of valid blind attempts and a valid passing control, and raw attempts were kept append-only and recomputed independently (`grade3-reading/artifacts/demo-unit-2026-07-10/items/02-gate-summary.md`, lines 8-14 and 40-45). A repair wave re-ran only evidence degraded by transport errors, because an errored blind attempt biases toward certifying an item and an errored control toward a false defect, and it never re-rolled a leaky verdict; it flipped 2 false certifications to leaky and 2 to inconclusive-defective (the same file, lines 46-49).
